description.value: The Kitimat Ice Rink is a municipally operated indoor ice facility in Kitimat, BC, serving the Haisla Nation's unceded territory on British Columbia's North Coast. Tagged in OSM as an ice hockey venue, it sits within the District of Kitimat's broader network of recreation centres that includes Tamitik Arena and the Riverlodge Recreation and Fitness Centre. For touring cyclists, it represents a public recreation anchor in an otherwise remote northern community.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The dedicated ice rink page at kitimat.ca returns a 404 error, so no amenity-level detail is available from the website. However, the District of Kitimat sitemap (crawled subpage) explicitly lists 'Kitimat Ice Rink' as an active facility under Recreation & Culture alongside Tamitik Arena and the Aquatic Centre, confirming the facility exists and is operated by the municipality. No OSM tags or website text provide evidence for any specific amenities such as bike parking, washrooms, or showers.
concerns: The OSM-listed URL (https://www.kitimat.ca/en/recreation-and-leisure/kitimat-ice-rink.aspx) returns a 404 error — the page has likely moved as part of a site redesign. No amenity-level information could be retrieved as a result.
No address or phone number present in OSM tags; specific contact details for the rink could not be confirmed.
OSM check_date is 2023-07-31; facility details should be re-verified against the updated District of Kitimat website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible municipal recreation facility confirmed by the District of Kitimat's own sitemap as of 2026; the 404 on the specific page is a website restructuring issue, not evidence the facility is closed.
enrichment_extras.notes: The District of Kitimat sitemap lists the Kitimat Ice Rink alongside Tamitik Arena under 'Kitimat Recreation and Community Centres' — it may be worth checking whether these are two names for the same facility or distinct venues at the same complex.

wow_evidence: Second ice facility record near Tamitik Arena (134m); possible overlap with the arena complex records.
